sentence: This project studies how the genome of Candida changes and how those changes affect how fast the fungal pathogens adapt to stress.
This project builds imaging methods that let researchers watch how cancer cells work in tumor environments.
This project studies how sleep and photoreceptors change the way the cortex processes complex visual stimuli.
This project studies how bladder cancer cells repair DNA damage, aiming to help develop treatments for bladder cancer.
This project builds a low-cost test that detects human papillomavirus nucleic acid for cervical cancer screening.
This project studies how the brain repairs itself after stroke and how neurons can be replaced.
This project builds a tool that measures proteins in single cells to study the tumor microenvironment.
This project studies how disrupting the SUMOylation pathway causes cell death and tumor regression in synovial sarcoma mouse models.
This project builds genetic reagents for studying gene function in Drosophila and describes where the targeted genes are expressed.
This project tests a technology that finds neoantigens, which are proteins made only by tumors.
This project studies how regulatory T cells survive and work when there is inflammation.
This project tries to find out how receptors inside heart cells and neurons get the G proteins they need to send signals.
This project studies how social experience shapes the basomedial amygdala and social behavior in adolescents and adults.
This project studies how genes affect blood lipid subfractions across age groups and environment.
This project studies how differently shaped amyloid fibrils interact with cellular factors in microengineered brain tissue.
This project tries to find targets for treating cystic fibrosis pulmonary inflammation by studying the nutritional requirements of T cells.
